model: Three Oaks Bakery: a monthly box?

N5.comment: 25 subscribers is too high for eight weeks. Say 20.

N11.comment: Need to ask the head baker about cross-contamination.

notes.text: December is our busiest month. Starting a box in November could swamp the Thursday bake.
notes.author: Owner

replies.view: Thursday ovens are free most of the year, but December runs them for Christmas orders too.
replies.question: Should the pilot end before December, or pause boxes for the Christmas weeks?
replies.author: AI assistant

replies.view: An eight-week pilot started in October would end in the busiest weeks and mix two effects in the numbers.
replies.question: Which start date gives eight clean weeks before the Christmas rush?
replies.author: AI assistant
